plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-12 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Environmental Studies program page and its linked official degree map workbook, 'Environmental Studies Degree Maps (2026-2027)', 'Environmental Studies (Campus)' tab, last updated/reviewed July 27, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (13/14/15/15/15/16/16/16) and the plan to the catalog's printed BA degree total of 120. BA-only program: the catalog prints a single line, Total Credits, BA Degree: 120, which the map matches exactly; no BS option is printed. The catalog's Bachelor of Arts Degree Requirement is 16 foreign-language credits (four semesters of a foreign language, or testing out and purchasing the credits; one semester may also fulfill the General Education Humanities requirement); the map's four LANG rows (1010/1020/2010/2020 at 4 credits each, correctly numbered in this map) satisfy it exactly. The catalog's General Education block prints only Core Course Requirements (12+ credits) and Breadth Area Requirements (16+ credits) with 'See General Education for course options'; the map's GE rows are recorded as printed. The catalog's Free Electives section prints no fixed figure (the total is determined by the General Education courses taken, degree type, additional credits earned and prerequisite courses needed); the map's free rows total 28 credits (2 + 3 + 3 + 3 upper-division + 8 upper-division + 7 + 2 upper-division), recorded as printed. Cross-check: the catalog's Environmental Studies Curriculum totals 63-65 credits (Foundation 3-4 + Core 27-28 + Capstone Research or Internship 3 + Electives 30), and the map exercises exactly 63: the Foundation at 3 (ENVS 1000), the Core at 27 (every named Core course appears; the Core's 'Complete One of the Following' mathematics choice is exercised at MATH 1190 - Introduction to Data Science, 3 credits, the bottom of the 3-4 range with MATH 1040 - Statistical Inference, 4, and MATH 1050 - College Algebra, 4 -- recorded as a choice slot with all three catalog options), the Capstone at 3, and the Electives at exactly their printed 30: the two 4-credit 'Natural Science Elective & Lab' slots total 8, the catalog's printed Natural Science minimum; the four Environment-Society slots (3 + 3 + 3 upper-division + 3) total 12, the catalog's printed Environment-Society minimum; and three further generic Environmental Studies elective slots (3 + 3 upper-division + one 4-credit upper-division slot in Spring Year 4, recorded as the single row the map prints) total the remaining 10. The catalog prints that students complete a minimum of 30 credits between the Natural Science and Environment-Society lists (at least the minimum in each area) and may complete additional courses from its General Environmental Studies Electives lists to meet the 30-credit requirement; the generic slots carry those lists. The catalog's Natural Science Electives list (at least 8 credits) is: AGSC 3560/3565, CHEM 3700, ENVS 4000 (0.5-3, up to 3 maximum), GEO 3150, GEO 3170/3175, GEO 3610/3615, GEOG 3110, GEOG 3220/3225, GEOG 3270 (also in the Core), GEOG 3350/3355, GEOG 3550, RANG 4200. The catalog's Environment-Society Electives list (at least 12 credits) is: AGSC 1010, ANTH 3001, ANTH 3500, ENVS 4900, GEOG 1300, GEOG 3600, HSS 1200, NR 1010, NR 3000, ORPT 3030, ORPT 3060, ORPT 4600, POLS 3410, PSY 3500, RANG 3600/3605, SOC 3410. Program information printed in the catalog: all courses must be passed with a C (2.0) or better to count in the major, and a minimum of 18 credit hours, including the capstone project, must be completed at SUU. Catalog titles are recorded where the map abbreviates (e.g. 'Human Geography' for GEOG 1400 - People and Place: Human Geography). Verification disclosure: an early read in the capture session returned a different, superseded heading structure for this page; repeated reads in that session and two fresh loads in a follow-up verification on 2026-11-12 all agreed exactly on the version transcribed here, which the official degree map matches. GE and elective rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes.
